title: Parseval identity for finite abelian groups
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $f:G\to\mathbb{C}$. The uniform inner product of $f$ with itself equals the sum, over all additive characters $\chi$ of $G$, of the squared absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ at $\chi$.
